# MeshWeave

> AI visibility risk analysis for citation, discovery, and agent trust.

MeshWeave audits how AI systems crawl, understand, and cite websites. It identifies structural weaknesses that limit visibility, citation confidence, generative discovery, and AI agent trust — then delivers a prioritized remediation roadmap. This file is a fuller reference for AI agents and LLMs that want to understand MeshWeave and link to it accurately.

## What MeshWeave does

When buyers ask AI tools what to buy, the AI quotes, recommends, and acts on the sites it can understand. MeshWeave finds the gaps that make a brand invisible, untrusted, or unusable to those systems, and turns them into concrete fixes.

It scores a site across three independent risk lenses and produces a prioritized list of changes ordered by revenue impact.

## Core Capabilities

- AI visibility risk analysis across three lenses: AEO, GEO, AAX
- Citation-readiness diagnostics (can AI quote your content by name?)
- Generative discovery optimization (does AI recommend you over competitors?)
- AI agent experience auditing (can AI navigate and act on your site?)
- Entity consistency and crawl-access auditing
- Prioritized, concrete remediation roadmap
- Private report history for signed-in users
- Personal API keys for programmatic access to owned private reports

## Three Risk Lenses

MeshWeave scores each lens on a 0–100 scale. Factors with no measured score are excluded and the remaining weights are renormalized, then the composite is calibrated to compress inflated upper-range scores.

- **AEO (Answer Engine Optimization)**: Whether AI can extract clear, trustworthy answers from your content. Failure means your brand is not quoted when buyers ask questions; competitors own the answer.
  Factors: Capture Rate (30%), Schema Implementation (20%), Content Structure (20%), Query Match (15%), Voice Rate (10%), Freshness (5%).
- **GEO (Generative Engine Optimization)**: Whether AI systems see sufficient authority, trust, and entity signals. Failure means your brand is overlooked or replaced in recommendations.
  Factors: Citation (30%), Topical Authority (20%), E-E-A-T Signals (15%), Crawl Access (15%), Content Depth (10%), Entity Consistency (10%).
- **AAX (AI Agent Experience)**: Whether AI agents can understand, assess, and act on your site reliably. Failure means agent-mediated buyers abandon before conversion.
  Factors: Homepage Comprehension (35%), Meta Optimization (20%), Content Delta (20%), llms.txt (5%), Email Validation (10%), Contactability (10%).

### Score ratings

- AEO / GEO: 0–25 Poor or Invisible, 26–45 Below Average or Emerging, 46–65 Average or Visible, 66–85 Strong or Authoritative, 86–100 Excellent or Dominant.
- AAX: 0–24 Opaque, 25–39 Unclear, 40–59 Readable, 60–79 Clear, 80–100 Fluent.

Scores are diagnostic signals, not guarantees of ranking, traffic, or conversion.

## API

Public analysis previews do not require authentication:

```http
GET https://meshweaveai.com/api/analysis/public/{key}
GET https://meshweaveai.com/api/analysis/public/{key}/summary
GET https://meshweaveai.com/api/domain/{domain}
GET https://meshweaveai.com/api/status/{crawl_id}
```

Signed-in users create API keys on `/profile`. The complete secret is returned
only once by `POST /api/keys`; keys can be listed by prefix and revoked from
`/profile`. A key cannot read another user's resources.

### v1 API (Bearer key)

All v1 endpoints are authenticated with `Authorization: Bearer mw_live_...`
and scoped to the key owner:

```http
# Bulk-submit up to 25 URLs (scope: "page" | "site"); each URL is admitted
# or rejected independently: queued | cooldown | quota | invalid.
# Queued crawls run on a durable queue and are private to the key owner.
# Targets on private/loopback/metadata networks (e.g. localhost, 127.0.0.1,
# 169.254.169.254) are rejected as invalid.
POST https://meshweaveai.com/api/v1/analyses
Content-Type: application/json

{"urls": ["https://example.com", "https://other.com"], "scope": "page"}

# List your analyses, newest-first (keyset pagination via next_cursor)
GET https://meshweaveai.com/api/v1/analyses?limit=50&cursor={last_id}

# Full private payload for one owned analysis (202 while running)
GET https://meshweaveai.com/api/v1/analyses/{crawl_id}

# Unbranded, client-ready Markdown audit report
GET https://meshweaveai.com/api/v1/analyses/{crawl_id}/report.md

# Progress diff vs the previous revision (JSON or Markdown):
# score deltas per lens + resolved findings. Predicted changes are per fix;
# observed changes are per lens (aggregate).
GET https://meshweaveai.com/api/v1/analyses/{crawl_id}/diff
GET https://meshweaveai.com/api/v1/analyses/{crawl_id}/diff.md
GET https://meshweaveai.com/api/v1/analyses/{crawl_id}/diff?vs={crawl_id}
```

Private responses include the complete crawl payload, score factors,
recommendations, and score snapshots. (Legacy alias for the private payload:
`GET /api/analysis/private/{crawl_id}`, which also accepts the owner's
browser session.) Contact `hello@meshweaveai.com` for bulk, commercial, or
expert-guided integrations.

## How to be more visible to AI

- Put clear, factual claims about your product near the top of each page.
- Add structured data (JSON-LD schema) for your organization, products, and FAQs.
- Maintain an `llms.txt` and a `robots.txt` that allow crawling.
- Keep entity names, addresses, and contact details consistent across the site.
- Write in short, declarative sentences that name the actor and the benefit.
